column5: Lys(i)-Glu(i+4): the Glu(i)-Lys(i+4) cell (-20) plus the orientation split of Baker et al. 2015 (PDB salt-bridge occupancy, RT ln[(1-f_KE)/(1-f_EK)] = -0.077 kcal/mol; Poisson-Boltzmann pair electrostatics and Baker's two-state dG agree)

FIRST_TURN_N2_OFFSET Lys: Leu's +0.25 was adopted because Lys at N2 was over-predicted under the default law; the GB law's own first-turn penalty reproduces the Cochran & Doig 2001 N1 and N2 Lys/Arg contrasts without it

FIRST_TURN_N2_OFFSET His by its own procedure (Tsuboyama et al. 2023 N2-minus-interior cost x 0.943 minus the model's electrostatic N2 offset at 25 C, 0.15 M, pH 7.4), with the GB law: +0.059 instead of +0.010
